messages:
product-lead: Heads-up: Realtime Multi-Model Gateway (mm-gateway) is GA today. This exposes `mm-gateway-v1` and the new `mm.gateway` endpoint for transparent routing across model variants (optimize for cost/latency/quality). Docs: https://redwood.ai/docs/mm-gateway (internal).

product-lead: Short bullets: 1) API: new `/v2/mm-gateway` + SDK helpers under `client.mm.gateway`. 2) Behavior: runtime can route requests to compatible model variants (e.g., fast/cheap -> high-quality) with automatic fallback. 3) Pricing: model-routing surcharge + model-unit costs; early-adopter credits for 30 days. 4) Deprecation: no immediate deprecations, but routing will be the recommended path for multi-model patterns.

eng-ml: Implementation notes: gateway supports affinity rules (latency_pref, cost_pref, quality_pref) and per-request hints. We added headers `x-rdwd-route` and `x-rdwd-fallback-reason`. If the gateway downgrades model you'll see `x-rdwd-route: fallback`.

devx: SDK example (py):
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
c = RedwoodClient()
for ev in c.mm.gateway.stream(model='mm-gateway-v1', input='Summarize for mobile', hints={'latency_pref':'low'}, stream=True):
    handle(ev)
```
Minimal bump to SDK; new helpers only.

infra-bot: infra-deploy-bot: Canary scheduled start=2150010800; stages 5%->20%->60%->100% over ~6h. Rollback window=2h. Canary keys in secrets/mm-gateway/canary/*. Watch signals: route-stability, fallback-rate, p95-latency.

sla-team: SLA note: hosted mm-gateway uses best-effort routing; latency SLOs documented per-route. Dedicated customers can lock routing policies and get mapped SLAs via account team. Contact sla-team for templates.

partners: Partners: do we need custom keys for preview partners?

product-lead: Yes, preview partner keys available; request via partner integrations. We have a partner readout tomorrow 10am PT.

legal: Data routing note: routing metadata may be retained for 30 days for debugging and quality. If a customer requires no-routing-telemetry, flag the account and legal will add clause.

devx: Observability: new Console -> Models -> mm-gateway-v1: route-splits, fallback-reason breakdown, per-variant latencies. We'll add a console toggle to pin routing per-account.

product-lead: Migration: mostly optional. Encourage teams to test `client.mm.gateway` for multi-model workflows. Launch call + runbook at 11:00 PT in #release-war-room — RSVP please. Huge thanks to eng-ml, infra, devx, and partners :tada:
